Bereshit Rabbah 1:14

R. Akiva's et-hermeneutic (from Nachum Ish Gam Zu): akh/rak = exclusions, ET/gam = INCLUSIONS — "et ha-shamayim includes sun, moon, constellations; et ha-aretz includes trees, grasses, Gan Eden"; the chain's own rule-system for the particle our TIR-014/015 reads as Theme-inventory — evidence line for the TIR catalog + unit note candidate
Bereshit Rabbah 3:2

GRAMMAR: "not with toil… by the word; 've-haya or' (and light SHALL BE) is NOT written — rather VA-YEHI or (and light WAS): it already was" — chain-primary derivation from the wayyiqtol mood that the result is instantaneous-complete: grounds our RESULT latency-0 reading (sister to BR 3:7's seder-zemanim mood argument)
Bereshit Rabbah 3:6

opens "va-yiqra Elohim la-or yom — but the light is not the day?!" — chain-primary articulation that the naming write binds LABEL≠ENTITY (our REGISTRY semantics); continues: the primordial light serves neither day nor night — nignezah ("hidden") for the righteous = the BR half of or-ha-ganuz, now read and locally verified (complements the Chagigah 12a amendment)
Bereshit Rabbah 3:7

Bereshit Rabbah 3:9

THE mixed-series question, asked by the chain itself: "if counting — say echad, shenayim, shelosha OR rishon, sheni, shlishi; but ECHAD then SHENI?!" (cardinal then ordinals — exactly our LEDGER label_form [OPEN] flag) — answered: repaid at the Mishkan's dedication ("ba-yom ha-rishon… first to creation"); amendment candidate: cite on the echad note
Bereshit Rabbah 17:1

the TEN-UTTERANCES census (asarah ma'amarot, Avot 5:1) listed line by line: Gen 1:1 COUNTS as an utterance though va-yomer ("and [God] said") is absent — grounded on Ps 33:6 "by the word of the LORD the heavens were made"; so does Gen 1:2's ruach ("wind/spirit") per R. Yaakov ben Kurshai, while Menachem bar Yosei swaps it for Gen 2:18 — the chain's own enumeration of the speech-act operator inventory, with recorded dissent, bearing on whether e1 carries an implicit MAAMAR (utterance) operator; amendment candidate for gen_01 e1

the TEN THINGS CREATED ON DAY ONE, each with its verse: heaven+earth (1:1), tohu+vohu (1:2!), light+darkness (1:2-3), wind+water (1:2), length-of-day+length-of-night (1:5) — the Bavli counts our presupposed items (tohu, vohu, choshekh, ruach, mayim) as day-one CREATIONS: the direct counterweight to BR 1:9's found-materials challenge; amendment candidate for the NOTE_PRESUPPOSED note (both chain resolutions recorded side by side)

continuation of the or-ha-ganuz passage the unit cites: hidden FOR WHOM — the righteous, from Gen 1:4 tov ("good") = righteous (Isa 3:10); extends ORAL_or_haganuz with the tov=righteous derivation (cf. BR 12:6 row 33)
Chagigah 12a:20

R. Akiva transmits Nachum Ish Gam Zu's et-exposition on Gen 1:1: WITHOUT et, "shamayim" could be read as the Creator's NAME (agent) — et forces the created-OBJECT reading; the Bavli's et-rule as explicit agent/Theme disambiguation, exactly TIR-014's Theme-marker semantics; amendment candidate: Bavli partner quote for the BR 1:14 evidence line
Megillah 21b:10

the Bavli's ten-utterances count: nine va-yomer + "bereshit is also an utterance, as it is written 'by the word of the LORD were the heavens made' (Ps 33:6)" — Bavli witness for today's ORAL_e1_maamar amendment (BR 17:1, row 37)
Rosh Hashanah 32a:19

third ten-utterances witness, adding the architecture: bereshit = ONE utterance creating all matter at once, "after which all matter was formed into separate entities by the other nine" — e1 as bulk-create, later utterances as differentiation; extends ORAL_e1_maamar
Onkelos Genesis 1:1

the authorized translation's rulings on e1: be-reshit -> BE-KADMIN ("at first" — temporal, confirming TIME_ANCHOR against the misparse the Ptolemy change guards); et -> YAT, the explicit Aramaic accusative marker — the Targum rendering et as pure object/Theme marker (TIR-014's side of the et question); amendment candidate alongside BR 1:14 + Chagigah 12a:20

the yom polysemy formally SPLIT: the registry label becomes YEMAMA ("daytime") while the ledger unit stays yoma — u-kra YY li-nehora yemama… yoma chad; and the cardinal is preserved: yoma CHAD ("ONE day"), not ordinalized — the authorized translation keeping exactly the anomaly BR 3:9 flags; direct witness for the REGISTRY-vs-LEDGER distinction and the echad [OPEN] note; amendment candidate

teach.work: Bereshit Rabbah 3:7 (on va-yehi erev, 1:5)
teach.he: יהי ערב אין כתיב כאן אלא ויהי ערב — מכאן שהיה סדר זמנים קדם לכן
teach.tr: yehi erev ein ketiv kan ela VA-yehi erev — mi-kan she-hayah seder zemanim qodem lakhen
teach.en: "'Let there be evening' is not written — rather 'AND there WAS evening': from here, an order of times existed beforehand." R. Yehuda b. Simon reads the wayyiqtol (not jussive!) of the commit formula — the same mood distinction TIR-026 encodes.

teach.work: Or ha-ganuz (hidden primordial light) — Bavli Chagigah 12a (R. Elazar)
teach.he: אור שברא הקב"ה ביום ראשון אדם צופה בו מסוף העולם ועד סופו כיון שנסתכל הקב"ה בדור המבול ובדור הפלגה וראה שמעשיהם מקולקלים עמד וגנזו מהן
teach.tr: or she-bara HKB'H be-yom rishon adam tzofeh bo mi-sof ha-olam ve-ad sofo; keivan she-nistakel be-dor ha-mabul u-ve-dor ha-flagah ve-ra'ah she-ma'aseihem mequlqalim, amad u-genazo mehen
teach.en: "The light the Holy One created on day one (or = light) — a person could see by it from one end of the world to the other; when He beheld the generation of the Flood and the generation of the Dispersion and saw their deeds corrupt, He arose and hid it (genazo) from them."

teach.work: Ten utterances (asarah ma'amarot) — Mishnah Avot 5:1, enumerated at Bereshit Rabbah 17:1
teach.he: תְּנֵינַן בַּעֲשָׂרָה מַאֲמָרוֹת נִבְרָא הָעוֹלָם, וְאֵלּוּ הֵן: בְּרֵאשִׁית, וְרוּחַ אֱלֹהִים מְרַחֶפֶת, וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים יְהִי אוֹר…
teach.tr: teneinan ba-asarah ma'amarot nivra ha-olam, ve-elu hen: be-reshit, ve-ruach Elohim merachefet, va-yomer Elohim yehi or…
teach.en: "We learned: with TEN UTTERANCES the world was created, and these are they: 'be-reshit' (1:1), 'and the spirit of God hovered' (1:2), 'and God said let there be light' (1:3) …" — the chain's own census of the account's speech-act operators. It counts e1 (Gen 1:1) as an utterance although va-yomer ("and He said") is absent there — grounded on Ps 33:6 ("by the word of the LORD the heavens were made") — and records dissent: Menachem bar Yosei removes the ruach utterance and substitutes Gen 2:18; R. Yaakov ben Kurshai retains it.

teach.work: The et rule — Bereshit Rabbah 1:14, Bavli Chagigah 12a:20 (Nachum Ish Gam Zu via R. Akiva), Targum Onkelos Gen 1:1
teach.he: אִילּוּ נֶאֱמַר ״שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ״, הָיִיתִי אוֹמֵר: ״שָׁמַיִם״ — שְׁמוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא. עַכְשָׁיו שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״אֵת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֵת הָאָרֶץ״ — שָׁמַיִם מַמָּשׁ, אָרֶץ מַמָּשׁ
teach.tr: ilu ne'emar 'shamayim va-aretz', hayiti omer: shamayim — shemo shel HKB'H; akhshav she-ne'emar 'ET ha-shamayim VE-ET ha-aretz' — shamayim mamash, aretz mamash
teach.en: "Had it said 'shamayim va-aretz' (heavens and earth), I would have said shamayim is the NAME of the Holy One; now that it says ET ha-shamayim ve-ET ha-aretz — actual heavens, actual earth" (Chagigah 12a:20): et disambiguates Agent-name from created OBJECT. Sister rule at BR 1:14: "akhin ve-rakin mi'utin, ETIN ve-gamin RIBUYIN" — akh/rak exclude, et/gam INCLUDE ("et ha-shamayim includes sun, moon, constellations; et ha-aretz includes trees, grasses, Gan Eden"). And the Targum rules in the grammar itself: Onkelos renders et as YAT, the explicit Aramaic object marker ("be-kadmin bera YY YAT shemaya ve-YAT ar'a").

teach.work: The cardinal echad — Bereshit Rabbah 3:9, Targum Onkelos Gen 1:5
teach.he: לֹא הָיָה צָרִיךְ לְמֵימַר אֶלָּא אֶחָד שְׁנַיִם שְׁלֹשָׁה, אוֹ רִאשׁוֹן שֵׁנִי וּשְׁלִישִׁי. שֶׁמָּא אֶחָד, שֵׁנִי, שְׁלִישִׁי, אֶתְמְהָא
teach.tr: lo hayah tzarikh le-meimar ela echad shenayim shelosha, o rishon sheni u-shlishi; shema echad, sheni, shlishi — etmeha?!
teach.en: "It should have said only echad, shenayim, shelosha (one, two, three) OR rishon, sheni, shlishi (first, second, third) — but ECHAD then SHENI?!" (BR 3:9) — the chain itself asks our LEDGER's mixed-series question, and answers by deferred repayment at the Mishkan's dedication ("va-yehi ha-makriv ba-yom ha-RISHON… first to creation"). Onkelos preserves the anomaly in translation: "yoma CHAD" (ONE day, cardinal kept) — and splits the yom polysemy: the registry label is rendered YEMAMA ("daytime") while the ledger unit stays yoma.

teach.work: The presupposed materials — Bereshit Rabbah 1:9 vs Bavli Chagigah 12a:6
teach.he: צַיָּר גָּדוֹל הוּא אֱלֹהֵיכֶם, אֶלָּא שֶׁמָּצָא סַמְּמָנִים טוֹבִים — תֹּהוּ וָבֹהוּ וְחֹשֶׁךְ וְרוּחַ וּמַיִם וּתְהוֹמוֹת. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: כּוּלְּהוֹן כְּתִיב בָּהֶן בְּרִיאָה
teach.tr: tzayar gadol hu Eloheikhem, ela she-matza samemanim tovim — tohu va-vohu ve-choshekh ve-ruach u-mayim u-tehomot; amar leih: kulhon ketiv bahen beriah
teach.en: The philosopher to Rabban Gamliel: "a great painter is your God — but He FOUND good pigments: tohu, vohu, darkness, wind, water, deeps." Gamliel: "creation is written of ALL of them," answering item by item from later Scripture (darkness: Isa 45:7 yotzer or u-vore choshekh). The Bavli's parallel resolution (Chagigah 12a:6): TEN things were created on DAY ONE — heavens and earth, tohu and vohu, light AND DARKNESS, wind and water, the measure of day and the measure of night — each with its day-1 verse.

teach.work: Theme order carries no temporal claim — Mekhilta DeRabbi Yishmael, Pischa 1:4
teach.he: שׁוֹמֵעַ אֲנִי, כָּל הַקּוֹדֵם בַּמִּקְרָא הוּא קוֹדֵם בַּמַּעֲשֶׂה; כְּשֶׁהוּא אוֹמֵר בְּיוֹם עֲשׂוֹת ה׳ אֱלֹהִים אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם, מַגִּיד שֶׁשְּׁנֵיהֶם שְׁקוּלִין זֶה בָזֶה
teach.tr: shome'a ani, kol ha-kodem ba-mikra hu kodem ba-ma'aseh; k'she-hu omer 'be-yom asot H' Elohim eretz ve-shamayim', magid she-SHNEIHEM SHEKULIN zeh ba-zeh
teach.en: "I might hear that whatever precedes in the VERSE precedes in the DEED; when it says (Gen 2:4) 'on the day the LORD God made EARTH AND HEAVENS' [reversed], it tells you the two are equal to one another." Tannaitic ruling: surface order in e1's Theme list carries no temporal claim.

teach.work: Result is instantaneous-complete — Bereshit Rabbah 3:2
teach.he: לֹא בֶעָמָל לֹא בִיגִיעָה בָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת עוֹלָמוֹ, אֶלָּא בִּדְבַר ה׳ — וְהָיָה אוֹר אֵין כְּתִיב כָּאן אֶלָּא וַיְהִי אוֹר, כְּבָר הָיָה
teach.tr: lo ve-amal lo vi-ygi'ah bara HKB'H et olamo, ela bi-dvar H' — VE-HAYA or ein ketiv kan ela VA-YEHI or: kevar hayah
teach.en: "Not with toil nor labor did the Holy One create His world, but by the word of the LORD (Ps 33:6) — 've-haya or' (and light SHALL BE) is not written here, but VA-YEHI or (and light WAS): it already was."

teach.work: The naming write binds label, not identity — Bereshit Rabbah 3:6
teach.he: וַיִּקְרָא אֱלֹהִים לָאוֹר יוֹם — לֹא הוּא אוֹר וְלֹא הוּא יוֹם, אֶתְמְהָא
teach.tr: va-yiqra Elohim la-or yom — lo hu or ve-lo hu yom, etmeha?!
teach.en: "'And God called the light day' — but the light is not [the same as] the day?! " — the chain opens by articulating that the naming write binds a LABEL to an entity without collapsing them; it continues with the primordial light serving neither day nor night, hidden (nignezah) for the righteous.

gen_01_creation_boot.census: utterances #1 and #2 — the opening word itself counts (the day-one canon), then “let there be light.”

gen_02_raqia_day.t: Day two: firmament — build, divide, name; commit without test (1:6-8)
mat: Avot DeRabbi Natan, Recension B 36:2
the TEN UTTERANCES census names yehi raqia explicitly in the va-yomer list; R. Yirmiyah's taninim variant rides — the census claim on 1:6, tannaitic co-witness
Bamidbar Rabbah 12:4
'Shelomo — He who instituted PEACE between fire and water, combined them, and crafted the firmament: shamayim = esh + mayim' — the 1:8 name read as the settlement of opposites
Bereshit Rabbah 17:1

the census WITH its machloket: main count includes ruach (1:2) making raqia #4; Menachem bar Yosei removes ruach (raqia #3), R. Yaakov ben Kurshai keeps it — the ordinal of 1:6's utterance is dispute-relative
Bereshit Rabbah 1:3
ANGELS CREATED DAY 2 (R. Yochanan, from Ps 104:3-4 on our verses) vs day 5 (R. Chanina) — machloket; both agree none day 1 ('who was partner with Me?')
Bereshit Rabbah 4:1
'He roofed His world only with water' (Ps 104:3) — the firmament as WATER-ROOF, against the stone-roof way of kings — the DECLARE's architecture reading
Bereshit Rabbah 4:2

THE CONGEALING: the middle drop congealed -> lower + upper heavens; Rav: FLUID DAY 1, CONGEALED DAY 2 ('yehi raqia = let it harden'); fire from on High passed over and dried/burnished it; raqia as hammered lining (vayraku, Exod 39:3)
Bereshit Rabbah 4:3

MIDPOINT ('be-tokh = at the exact middle'); and the me-al derivation: 'it does not say ON the firmament but ABOVE it' -> THE UPPER WATERS ARE SUSPENDED BY THE WORD; like the flame in a lamp; their fruits are rain
Bereshit Rabbah 4:4
R. Meir and the Samaritan: the finger/tube demonstration defends the suspension empirically; R. Yochanan: the primordial waters split HALF to the firmament, HALF to the ocean (peleg/palga)
Bereshit Rabbah 4:5

the measures: dome-over-pool rain mechanics; firmament thickness machloket (sheet of metal / 2-3 fingers); RATIO MACHLOKET: upper waters exceed lower by THIRTY (lamed of la-mayim = 30, gematria) vs the Rabbis: half-and-half
Bereshit Rabbah 4:6

ben Zoma on 'made' vs the word (Ps 33:6); THE MISSING KI-TOV, four answers carried: Gehenna created on it; DIVISION created on it (R. Chanina; R. Tavyomei's a-fortiori: if division-for-good lost the tov, division-for-turmoil all the more so); water-work incomplete until day 3 (R. Shmuel bar Nachman — day 3's double tov); water's future penal career
Bereshit Rabbah 4:7
the NAME: shamayim = esh + mayim integrated (Rav); sa-mayim 'bearing water' (R. Yitzchak); shamim/assessing; the milk-and-rennet congealing figure — 'moist on day one, congealed on the second'
Chagigah 15a:4

the GAP between upper waters and firmament, four positions: a thread's thickness / boards of a bridge / two robes / two cups — and the ruach hovered day 1, division day 2 (the temporal boundary of our span)
Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:2:2

the ten-verse problem on OUR paragraph: Sunday = 1:1-5 + 1:6-8 = eight verses; the REPEAT vs SPLIT machloket (Cahana/Assi), the splitter cutting 1:8's va-yehi erev as its own verse — the tradition's own verse-arithmetic on the span
Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:1:2

yom sheni (1:8) probed for calendar counting and EXCLUDED: 'one makes no inferences from the Creation of the World — they are God's days, not human days' — a chain LIMIT on the COMMIT ordinal as legal precedent
Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:3:3

THE MONDAY FAST: 'On Monday they were fasting for TRAVELLERS AT SEA — God commanded: there shall be a spread in the midst of the water' — the ma'amadot key our verse to the sea's safety; same source owns day-4's me'erot reading (chain-primary of the fast cycle)
Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Bereshit 12:1

the angels machloket anchored ON 1:6 (R. Yochanan via Ps 104:3-4; R. Chanina day 5) — with the CONVERGENT rationale both hold: created only after creation began, 'so none can say they assisted' (Isa 44:24)
Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Bereshit 1:1
angels day-2 anchor again + R. YEHUDA vs R. NECHEMIAH: world created over six days vs ALL created day one — R. Yehuda's proof is the per-day VA-YEHI KHEN including our 1:7
Midrash Tehillim 119:25

'FOREVER YOUR WORD STANDS IN THE HEAVENS' — upon what do the heavens stand? UPON THE UTTERANCE 'let there be an expanse'; 'He commanded and it STOOD' (Ps 33:9) — the 1:6 ma'amar as the STANDING structural support of the firmament
Midrash Tehillim 148:1

'He established them forever, an ordinance that will not pass' — He said yehi raqia and FROM THAT DAY THEY DID NOT MOVE — the standing-ordinance reading; heavens-of-heavens carry the upper waters (1:8 cited)
Mishnah Ta'anit 4:3

THE CASE TABLE: Sunday reads 1:1-8, Monday reads 1:6-13 — our span is the cycle's overlap, read twice; 'a long passage by two, a short one by one' — the input->output rows anchoring the span's liturgical identity
Onkelos Genesis 1:6
translation observation: be-tokh rendered 'in the MIDDLE of the waters' — Onkelos writes BR 4:3's midpoint into the authorized translation
Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 4:1

the DAY-2 CREATION LIST: firmament, ANGELS, fire for flesh-and-blood, and THE FIRE OF GEHINNOM (co-witness to BR 4:6's Gehenna answer); WHICH raqia? R. Eliezer: the one above the Chayyot (Ezek 1:22) — not 1:1's heavens; 'were it not for that firmament the world would be engulfed'
Shemot Rabbah 30:13
'it does not say THE LORD said let there be a firmament, but GOD [Elohim]' — the agent name on our DECLARE read as the ATTRIBUTE OF JUSTICE, uniform through creation
Taanit 27b:10
the Bavli's arithmetic on OUR paragraph: yehi raqia read BY ONE 'as it is three verses' — the span's own verse-count derived in the reading law
Targum Jonathan on Genesis 1:7

the tradition INLINES the suspension mechanics into the verse: God made the expanse 'UPBEARING IT WITH THREE FINGERS between the confines of the heavens and the waters of the ocean' — the BR 4:4 finger figure written into the authorized-expansive translation
Vayikra Rabbah 36:1

HEAVENS-FIRST vs EARTH-FIRST (Beit Shammai / Beit Hillel) with the synthesis: 'regarding CREATION the heavens were first; regarding COMPLETION the earth was first' — day 2 as the heavens' COMPLETION event; R. Shimon b. Yochai: created together like a pot and its lid
kept: seven barren women <-> seven days; day 2 <-> Rebecca, the divider's day ('I will separate you', Lev 20:26) — homiletic correspondence

teach.work: Bereshit Rabbah 4:6 (on the missing ki-tov, 1:7)

Polarity DISPUTED, delta itself and the 3:17 linkage converged
Bereshit Rabbah 12:4

Nechemya of Kefar Sichon — three bases (earth day 1 / firmament day 2 / water day 3), each waits three days and delivers three products (day 3: trees, vegetation, Eden); R. Azarya's two-base variant (heavens→lights day 4, earth→man day 6). Day 3 = the earth's DELIVERY day in every model; model choice = recorded dispute
Chullin 60a:10

Shimon ben Yochai: created together like pan and cover; R. Eleazar b. R. Shimon: equivalent. The incubation arithmetic run BOTH ways — 1:11's day-3 sprouting stands in every model
Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:7:4

Preserved wobbles: the fronted perfects of 11:12/11:14 (ve-arpakhshad chaya, ve-shelach chaya — the two-row anomaly survives word order); the itam crux (u-nefaku IMHON, 'and they went out WITH THEM' — unresolved); 11:32's kol-less total (va-havo yomei terach — no 'all' in the Aramaic either); the doubled absence at 11:30 with the hapax kept as COGNATE (leit lah VELAD — the child-word survives translation as itself). ha-mabul ('the deluge') exits as tufana (the Aramaic flood-word) in the same verse-final seat. 11:28's father-idiom kept literal (al apei, 'upon the face of' — the buffer does NOT insert 'in the lifetime of'; the chain's gloss war stays outside the translation). Ur becomes Ura de-Khasdaei; moledet ('birthplace') becomes yaladuteih ('his birth'). The template stretch renders mechanically — begettings as oléd, the rows' rhythm intact; the plainest Aramaic since Gen 5, broken exactly where the Hebrew breaks.

gen_27_the_call.t: The call: go to the land I will show you (12:1-9)
mat: Avodah Zarah 9a:7

F — THE WORLD-ERA CLOCK: the two thousand years OF TORAH begin at OUR 12:5 "the souls they made in Haran" — the 6,000-year frame (desolation / Torah / Messiah) pinned to our verse; the tradition holds Abraham was FIFTY-TWO then — numeric claim, read open (guard 3)
Berakhot 55a:8
F — the cup-of-blessing law: one given a cup to bless who does not bless — the punishment-proof is OUR 12:3 "I will bless those who bless you"; live blessing law on our ink
Bereshit Rabbah 39:1

F — R. Yitzchak's BURNING BUILDING parable: Abraham inferred an owner for the world, and the owner looked out — "the Lord said to Abram" — the call as ANSWER to Abraham's inference; the Psalm 45:11 listen-daughter frame
Bereshit Rabbah 39:11

F — the 12:2 dossier: THREE GREATNESSES + FOUR BLESSINGS counted in the ink = three patriarchs + four matriarchs (R. Levi bar Chavyat); travel diminishes three things — procreation, means, name — and the verse's three promises repair each IN ORDER (R. Chiyya: a clause-to-clause machine); Abraham's COIN (elderly pair / young pair — the four coin-bearers census); R. Yudan: the Amida blessing fixed for him, and YOURS PRECEDES MINE — "Shield of Abraham" before "revives the dead"; the added-heh claim on hashamaima (15:5, feeds gen_31); avarekhekha = 248 by count; berakha read as berekha (pool — purifies the distant); the blessings HANDED OVER to Abraham
Bereshit Rabbah 39:12

F — He is more exacting for the righteous man's honor than His own: His own honored "by others" (I Samuel 2:30), Abraham's "I, Myself" (OUR 12:3 "I will curse"); the BOWING LAW censused here (bow at Patriarchs and thanksgiving, start and end; one who bows at every blessing is taught not to; High Priest / king grades) — live Amida law seated on venivrekhu; rains and dews by your merit
Bereshit Rabbah 39:13
F — Lot subordinate ("went WITH him"); the 75-YEARS arithmetic carried to Esther: Rav 40 / Shmuel 80 / the Rabbis 75 (Hadasa's count) — the redeemer-at-75 claim built on OUR 12:4's number
Bereshit Rabbah 39:14

F — "the souls they MADE in Haran" = the converts; whoever draws near and converts an idolater IS AS THOUGH HE CREATED HIM (the gnat argument); Abraham converted the men, SARAH the women (the plural asu carrying her agency)
Bereshit Rabbah 39:15

F — "the Canaanites were THEN in the land" = they still held right to it; the altar built only on the tidings of the Land (12:7); Beit El → Beit Aven proleptic renaming; INK: 12:8 OHOLOH WRITTEN WITH FINAL HEH — "he pitched HER tent": Sarah's tent first — the SAME ketiv class as Noah's ohaloh at 9:21 (gen_23 row 3) — cross-witnessed pair
Bereshit Rabbah 39:16

F — THREE ALTARS census (R. Elazar): tidings / acquisition / that-his-descendants-not-fall-at-Ai (Joshua 7:6 cashes it); vayikra = he made every mouth proclaim the Name, and = he began converting; 12:9 "journeying to the Negev" = charting toward the Temple site
Bereshit Rabbah 39:8

F — LEKH LEKHA TWICE, the recorded machloket: R. Yehuda — two departures (Aram Naharayim + Aram Nachor); R. Nechemya — one, plus the FLIGHT FROM BETWEEN THE PIECES BACK TO HARAN — the chronology-inversion claim (Genesis 15 BEFORE 12:4; Abraham 70 at the Pieces, 75 here, per Seder Olam) — feeds gen_31's ordering dispute; the permission claim (he did not leave until permitted); dew-of-youth (sins evaporate); R. Levi's weeding and hoeing scene ending at 12:7
Bereshit Rabbah 39:9

F — R. Yochanan's three-term parse of 12:1 (your district / your neighborhood / your father's household); the WITHHOLDING RULE: destination concealed to endear it and pay REWARD PER STRIDE — with its census (the land I will show you / one of the mountains / Jonah's proclamation / Ezekiel's valley); the two lekh-lekhas ranked — Moriah dearer
Bereshit Rabbah 40:2
F — the chastisement frame: famine confronted him AT DEPARTURE and he did not complain — "You instruct him from Your Torah" — the no-protest claim bridging our promise (12:2) to the descent (12:10)
Bereshit Rabbah 40:4

F — "now I know you are fair" resolved: travel diminishes, she retained; and the PRINCIPAL-BECOME-SUBORDINATE typology (Abraham with Barak/Deborah as the pair): 12:5 he took her → 12:13 "say you are my sister" → 12:16 "he benefitted Abram FOR HER SAKE" — a three-step arc in the ink
Bereshit Rabbah 41:3

F — silver-and-gold foreshadows the Exodus (Psalm 105:37); "on his journeys" = the same routes back — HE PAID HIS CREDIT DEBTS (R. Elazar ben R. Menachem); LOT'S FOUR BENEFITS census (12:4 / 13:5 / 14:16 / 19:29) against the four troubles, the sin recorded in four places, four prophets sealing the sentence — a fourfold ledger machine
Bereshit Rabbah 41:5

F — the muzzled-animals quarrel AT LAW: Abraham's beasts muzzled (theft!), Lot's not; the herdsmen's inheritance argument from OUR 12:7; God's ruling — "to your descendants" only when the seven nations are uprooted (15:16); "the Canaanites... then" = their right still stands (pairs with row 8)
Bereshit Rabbah 44:12

F — the ASTROLOGY-ANNULMENT dossier (15:5's hachutza): above the dome, habata is downward; "you are a prophet, not an astrologer"; the THREE THINGS that annul decrees (prayer, charity, repentance) + name-change, good deed, PLACE-CHANGE — the last from OUR 12:1 — + the fast; feeds gen_31
Bereshit Rabbah 49:9

F — the justice-argument dossier closing at OUR 12:1 (ten generations, only-with-you); Rav Ada's argument: the oath bars a water flood — A FLOOD OF FIRE evades it? (the gen_22 oath-scope machloket ARGUED BY ABRAHAM); INK: every tzadikim of Sodom WRITTEN WITHOUT YOD (inferior righteous) — defective-spelling claim read open (guard 3)
Chullin 49a:18
F — RULING-DERIVATION: R. Akiva's source that the BLESSERS OF ISRAEL ARE BLESSED (priests included) is OUR 12:3 (Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak) — priestly-blessing law on our ink
Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:6:3

F — the DEROGATORY-RENAMING LAW's sugya carries OUR 12:8 station: Beit El formerly, now Beit Aven — the idolatry-naming rule (call the eye of the cup the eye of the thorn) with the amida/amila exchange — our verse's geography inside the halakhic renaming machine
Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:2:4

F — THE DEW OATH: "when Abraham did My will I swore dew never departs from his descendants" (Psalm 110:3-4, the Abraham psalm); dew descends by NO creature's merit (vs rain, prayed down) — the dew/rain asymmetry in the liturgical law, granted at the call's reward complex
Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:3:1
F — THE MISHNAH at its JT seat: the blessings-and-curses location fixed BY GEZERAH SHAVAH from OUR 12:6 — elon Moreh here = Shechem there (middah II, the equal-cut named in the halakhah)
Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:3:4

F — the SAMARITAN FALSIFICATION charge: "you wrote 'Shechem' into your Torah beside the terebinths and gained nothing — you do not expound the equal cut; we do, from OUR 12:6" — a recorded rival-text variance adjudicated by our verse; R. Yishmael's fourteen-years rule rides the sugya
Mishnah Kiddushin 4:14

F — RULING: the Mishnah's closing testimony — ABRAHAM KEPT THE WHOLE TORAH BEFORE IT WAS GIVEN (Genesis 26:5), sealed with "Abraham was old... blessed with everything" — the pre-Sinai observance claim as a standing fact over the entity our unit boots
Mishnah Sotah 7:5

F — THE MISHNAH (the ruling over rows 34-35): the full ceremony case-table — six tribes on Gerizim, six on Ebal, the gezerah shavah from OUR 12:6 as the location source, the Torah on the stones IN SEVENTY LANGUAGES
Pesachim 117b:11

F — Reish Lakish maps 12:2's clauses onto the AMIDA'S FIRST BLESSING: "I will make you a great nation" = "God of Abraham"; "I will bless you" = "God of Isaac"; "I will make your name great" = "God of Jacob" — the verse's clause order structuring live liturgy (with the seal Shield-of-Abraham riding the adjacent segment)
Rosh Hashanah 16b:7

F — the Bavli seat of PLACE-CHANGE annulment: "and some say also change of place, as written lekh lekha... and after, I will make you a great nation" — WITH the recorded dissent: the other holds it was the MERIT OF THE LAND, not the move — dual-tracked
Sanhedrin 99b:12

F — Reish Lakish: WHOEVER TEACHES TORAH TO ANOTHER'S CHILD, the verse credits him AS THOUGH HE FORMED HIM — from OUR 12:5's "souls they made"; R. Elazar (as though he fashioned the Torah's words) and Rava's al-tikrei (fashioned himself) extending it
Sifrei Devarim 311:1

F — REGIME CHANGE AT THE CALL: before Abraham the world was judged by the measure of cruelty (flood drowned, tower dispersed, Sodom burned); FROM ABRAHAM, chastisements replace catastrophes — the proof is OUR 12:10's famine; the borders-of-the-peoples set by Israel's number
Sotah 38b:3
F — RULING-DERIVATION, second Bavli seat: ANY PRIEST WHO BLESSES IS BLESSED, one who does not is not (R. Yehoshua ben Levi) — from OUR 12:3; pairs with row 29's R. Akiva derivation
rows: Mekhilta DeRabbi Yishmael, Tractate Vayehi Beshalach 3:7

Bereshit Rabbah 40:6

Hoshaya's name): "go and pave the way before your descendants" — ELEVEN matched ink-pairs Abraham↔Israel: famine=famine (45:6), descended=descended (Numbers 20:15), to-sojourn=to-sojourn (47:4), severe=severe (43:1), hikriv=hikriv (Exodus 14:10), kill-me/keep-you-alive=cast-sons/keep-daughters (Exodus 1:22), yitav-li=vayeitev (Exodus 1:20), arrival=arrival (Exodus 1:1), wealth=silver-and-gold exit (Psalm 105:37), Pharaoh-commanded=Egypt-urged (Exodus 12:33), his-journeys=their-journeys (Numbers 33:1) — the typology machine over our whole span
Bereshit Rabbah 41:1
F — the palm-and-cedar frame closing on OUR 12:17: ONE NIGHT's taking → he and his household afflicted — whoever accosts Israel is repaid by their hand, Sarah the proof
Bereshit Rabbah 41:2

F — the afflictions dossier: RAATAN, the one disease that blocks relations — the measure exactly matching the crime; even the palace BEAMS stricken; Sarah prostrate all night ("Abraham left with a promise, I on faith; he outside the cage, I within it") — "all I do, I do for you"; the ANGEL WITH THE ROD acting at her word (al devar = by Sarai's word); and the NAMED GEZERAH SHAVAH al devar / al devar (12:17 ↔ 20:18) transferring leprosy↔obstruction between Pharaoh and Avimelekh — middah II on our ink
Bereshit Rabbah 51:6
F — Lot's remembered merit at 19:29 = his SILENCE here: he knew "she is my sister" (our plot) was cover and said nothing — our episode cashed a chapter later
Bereshit Rabbah 52:4
F — the CONSENT CONTRAST: in Egypt "PLEASE say" (12:13 — imri na, solicited); at Gerar he said it of her by force — our verse's na read as request; the seven names of the south on our negev route
Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:9:3

F — the raatan claim at its HALAKHIC seat: the compelled-divorce sugya (the Mishnah's list of conditions forcing divorce) carries "and with it wicked Pharaoh was stricken — as written, OUR 12:17"; attribution variance recorded (R. Shmuel bar Nachman in R. Yonatan's name here; anonymous in Bereshit Rabbah 41:2); the 24-cedars digression rides the number
Mekhilta DeRabbi Shimon Ben Yochai 3:1

F — [Hebrew read] "NO SLAVE OR MAIDSERVANT EVER WENT FREE FROM EGYPT EXCEPT HAGAR — as it is said (OUR 12:20): and they sent him away, him and his wife and all that was his" — the unique-release claim on our exit verse, seating Hagar's Egyptian origin (feeds gen_32) inside the thornbush sugya's Egypt-harshness claim
Sanhedrin 39b:21

F — INK-GRADED BEAUTY: Abishag "fair AD me'od" = up to but NOT including; Sarah (OUR 12:14) "me'od" itself — "she did not reach half of Sarah's beauty" (R. Chanina bar Pappa) — the exclusive-ad parse on our token
Sotah 46b:14

F — THE ESCORT LAW: for FOUR STEPS Pharaoh escorted Abraham (OUR 12:20 "commanded men concerning him") he was repaid four hundred years of his descendants' service (15:13) — measure-for-measure arithmetic on our verse; the standing escort rules (accompany four cubits in a city → no harm) ride it
Vayikra Rabbah 16:1

F — the seven-abominations leprosy census: "he who incites discord among brothers" = PHARAOH between Abraham and Sarah, proof OUR 12:17's vaynaga; R. Meir's count machloket (six and seven are THIRTEEN vs the Rabbis' seven) — counted claim, read open; the metzora = motzi-shem-ra etymology sealing it
Vayikra Rabbah 32:5

F — SARAH FENCED HERSELF in Egypt and all the women were fenced by her merit — the four-things redemption census (name, language, no slander, no licentiousness) with our episode as the female pole; the language leg cites 14:13 "Abram the Hebrew" (feeds gen_30)
Yevamot 13b:6

F — THE DIRECTIONAL-HEH RULE at its halakhic seat: R. Nechemya — a word needing lamed at its start takes HEH AT ITS END; the school of Rabbi Yishmael's census includes OUR mitzraima (12:10) — the grammar rule the unit's morphology already encodes, here with chain authority

teach.en: The span's translation witness — headline: THE BUFFER GIVES SARAI THE WORDS THE LETTER WITHHOLDS: 12:13 gains an instrument — 'that my soul may be PRESERVED BY YOUR WORDS' (be-fitgamaykhi): in the Hebrew her speech is demanded and never delivered; in the Aramaic her words are already the saving cause [find-class; dual-track, flagged]. The person-taking buffer holds through ALL THREE take-forms: va-tuqach -> ve-idabbarat ('she was LED'), va-eqach -> u-devarit ('I LED her'), qach -> devar ('LEAD [her]') — the lead-for-take policy gen_26 found at 11:31, now passive, confessional, and imperative. VA-LEKH -> IZEL: Pharaoh's go-word is the same Aramaic imperative Onkelos gave 12:1's lekh-lekha (izel lakh) — the letter's frozen-wall echo survives translation exactly. The expulsion SOFTENED: va-yeshalchu -> ve-ALVIU ('they ESCORTED/accompanied him') — the garden-stem's rhyme is buffered away into an honor guard. The plague DE-TACTILIZED: va-yenaga -> ve-aiti ('He BROUGHT plagues upon'), negaim -> makhtashin — the same Aramaic noun the law's buffer uses for nega [cross-buffer consistency]. NA ('please') -> khe-an ('now') both times — the corpus's first please vanishes in translation. raav -> kafna; kaved -> takif ('severe'); la-gur -> le-itotava ('to dwell').

Arakhin 16b:18
F — R. Yosei ben R. Chanina's alternate source: "on his journeys" — with the recorded practical difference between the two derivations (temporary lodging) — a two-source dispute on our ink
Bava Batra 100a:7

F — WALKING ACQUISITION at the Bavli: R. Eliezer's reason IS OUR 13:17 "arise, walk the land... for I will give it to you"; the Rabbis — love-of-Abraham, to ease his descendants' conquest — the kinyan machloket seated on our verse

Bava Kamma 93a:2
F — the PROVERB SOURCED: "drag wood after a property owner" — Rabba bar Mari's source is OUR 13:5 "Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks..." — folk-maxim rooted in our ink

Bereshit Rabbah 41:4

teach.en: The span's translation witness — HEADLINE: THE MEMRA DOUBLE-ENTRY. 15:1's anokhi magen lakh ('I am your shield') -> MEIMRI TEQOF LAKH ('My WORD is your STRENGTH'), and 15:6's ve-heemin ba-YHWH -> ve-hemin BE-MEIMRA da-YHWH ('he believed in the WORD of YHWH'): the buffer sets the Memra at BOTH ends of the faith-exchange — God's I becomes God's Word and the belief lands on the Word — in the chapter the letter itself frames as a word-event; and the genre is named outright: ba-machazeh -> BI-NEVUAH ('in PROPHECY') [find-class: theology-insertion, flagged]. SECOND: THE RITE LITURGIZED — qechah li ('take for Me') -> QAREV KODAMAI ('OFFER BEFORE Me') and va-yiqach-lo -> ve-qarev kodamohi ('he offered before Him'): the korban-verb two books before Leviticus, with the kodam-distancing on both command and compliance (gen_30's meshamesh-kodam family); AND the threefold read as THREE-OF-EACH (eglin telata, 'three calves...') — the menagerie 5 -> 11 [famous buffer arithmetic, dual-track]. THIRD: the 15:6 watch-point answered — ve-chashvah leih: the buffer KEEPS BOTH PRONOUNS BARE (declines to vote on the famous ambiguity — exactly its behavior at gen_30's tithe), while tzedaqah -> ZAKHU ('merit'): the same merit-root the buffer gave Noach's tzaddik (frozen gen_17's zakkai buffer) [repeat-policy]. REPEAT BUFFERS CONSISTENT WITH FROZEN RECORDS: seed -> sons (zarekha -> benakh/li-vnakh at 15:5, 15:13, 15:18 — gen_29's 13:15 buffer exactly); tardemah -> plain SHINTA ('sleep') — the SAME flattening gen_09 recorded at 2:21: both covenant sleeps lose their depth in Aramaic; rekhush -> QINYANA (gen_30's property-noun, now on the exodus wealth); Refaim -> GIBARAEI ('the mighty' — gen_30's 14:5 epithet verbatim); the identification class continues (ha-qeni -> SHALMAEI, the Kenite named as the Salmaean — gen_30's Salem-to-Jerusalem move on a new name). Also: ariri -> be-la VELAD ('without a child' — the gloss-fix vindicated); ben-mesheq -> BAR PARNASA ('the provision-steward' — the hapax resolved to an office); dameseq -> DAMASQAAH (the city turned gentilic — the wordplay resolved); mi-meekha -> bar DE-TOLID ('the son you will BEGET' — the body-idiom flattened); ba-tavekh -> BE-SHAVEH ('EQUALLY' — geometry to arithmetic); henah x2 SPLIT (haka 'here' / ad KEAN 'until now'); avon -> CHOVA ('debt' — iniquity as ledger); lo shalem -> la SHELIM (the sibling-skeleton kept); natati -> YEHAVIT (the perfect KEPT — the receipt survives translation); karat brit -> GEZAR QEYAM ('CUT a pact' — the cut-idiom SURVIVES in Aramaic here, where gen_22 recorded it dying at 9:11: the buffer's own covenant-idiom is cut-based) [delta vs frozen record, flagged].

teach.tr: ve-tzalliat bi-shma da-YHWH … qabil YHWH tzelotikh
teach.en: The span's translation witness — HEADLINE: THE PRAYER DOUBLE THAT UN-NAMES GOD. At 16:11 ki-shama YHWH el-onyekh ('for YHWH has HEARD your AFFLICTION') becomes arei QABIL YHWH TZELOTIKH ('YHWH has RECEIVED your PRAYER' — the affliction itself replaced by prayer), and at 16:13 va-tiqra shem-YHWH ('she CALLED THE NAME of YHWH') becomes VE-TZALLIAT BI-SHMA da-YHWH ('she PRAYED in the name of YHWH') — the tzali-family (frozen record: gen_27's call-as-prayer, gen_29's ve-tzali, gen_30's oath-in-prayer) fires TWICE in one chapter and DISSOLVES the corpus's only human-naming-of- God exactly where the machine registers it; her epithet is universalized (elaha de-chazei KHOLA, 'the God who sees ALL') and her hard reason-clause rebuilt as revelation ('have I even here begun to see, AFTER HE WAS REVEALED to me'); the well too loses the Name — 16:14 -> 'the well at which the ENDURING ANGEL APPEARED' [find-class: systematic un-naming, flagged]. SECOND: the PERE-ORACLE SOFTENED — pere adam -> MAROD BE-ENASHA ('a REBEL among men') and the hand-clauses turned economy ('he will be NEEDY of all, and the hands of men will be NEEDY of him') — the wild-ass domesticated to mutual commerce [dual-track]. REPEAT BUFFERS CONSISTENT WITH FROZEN RECORDS: 16:2's va-yishma le-qol -> VE-QABIL le-MEIMAR ('accepted the WORD') — the EXACT buffer frozen gen_11 recorded at 3:17: the two wife-listenings get one rendering; 16:3's va-tiqach -> U-DEVARAT ('she LED') — the lead-for-take policy (gen_26's 11:31, gen_28's triad, gen_30's dvar) now on Sarai; Qadesh -> REQAM (gen_30's 14:7 identification verbatim) with Shur AND Bered both mapped to CHAGRA (identification class; the Hagar-echo in the toponym is the buffer's); zarekh -> BENAYKHI ('your SONS' — the seed-to-sons policy, gen_29/gen_31, extended to the maid's line); the doubling KEPT (harbah arbeh -> asgaa asgei — the buffer preserves the inf-abs pair); ve-hitani -> ve-ISHTABEDI ('be enslaved' — submission hardened to servitude); chamasi -> DIN LI ALAKH ('I have a CASE against you') with yishpot -> yedin — grievance and demand harmonized into din-vocabulary; ariri-class concretions continue (ben-mesheq precedent): shifchah -> amta throughout.
